entities.name: Michał Kubiak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michał Jarosław Kubiak is a Polish professional volleyball player who plays as an outside hitter for Shanghai Bright. He is a former member of the Poland national team, a participant in the Olympic Games, two–time World Champion, and the 2012 World League winner.
